title: Deluge Exporter (InfluxDB 2.x)
description: Sample dashboard for DelugeExporter (https://github.com/clara-j/DelugeExporter), InfluxDB 2.x queries. Pick a Flux data source and set Bucket to the exporter's INFLUXDB_BUCKET. Queries aggregate per torrent, so they also work with YEAR_TAG=true.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stats" and (r._field == "torrents_count"))
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "torrents_count"}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "torrent" and (r._field == "state_code"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group(columns: ["hex", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["hex"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["hex"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.state_code == 3.0)
  |> count(column: "hex")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.hex, _field: "count"}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "torrent" and (r._field == "state_code"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group(columns: ["hex", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["hex"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["hex"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.state_code == 4.0)
  |> count(column: "hex")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.hex, _field: "count"}))

panels.title: Cannot finish

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "torrent" and (r._field == "distributed_copies" or r._field == "state_code"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group(columns: ["hex", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["hex"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["hex"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.distributed_copies < 1.0 and r.state_code == 3.0)
  |> count(column: "hex")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.hex, _field: "count"}))

panels.description: Downloading torrents with fewer than one complete copy among connected peers: they cannot finish as things stand.

panels.title: Errors

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "torrent" and (r._field == "tracker_ok" or r._field == "message_ok" or r._field == "state_code"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group(columns: ["hex", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["hex"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["hex"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.tracker_ok == 0.0 or r.message_ok == 0.0 or r.state_code == 6.0)
  |> count(column: "hex")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r.hex, _field: "count"}))

panels.description: Torrents in the Error state, with a Deluge error message, or with a tracker error or warning (such as an unregistered torrent).

panels.title: Data problems

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stats" and (r._field == "recv_failed_bytes"))
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Corrupt data received / hour"}))

from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "stats" and (r._field == "disk_queued_write_bytes"))
  |> group()
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "Waiting to be written to disk"}))

panels.description: Corrupt data comes from peers failing hash checks. A growing write queue means the disk is the bottleneck.

panels.title: Torrents

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "torrent" and (r._field == "state_code" or r._field == "progress" or r._field == "ratio" or r._field == "seeding_time" or r._field == "total_size" or r._field == "distributed_copies" or r._field == "tracker_ok" or r._field == "upload_payload_rate"))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: float(v: r._value)}))
  |> group(columns: ["name", "label", "_field"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["name", "label"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Torrent: r.name, Label: if exists r.label then r.label else "", State: r.state_code, Progress: r.progress, Ratio: r.ratio, Seeding: r.seeding_time, Size: r.total_size, Availability: r.distributed_copies, Tracker: r.tracker_ok, Upload: r.upload_payload_rate}))

panels.description: One row per torrent. Sorted by ratio, lowest first; click a header to re-sort.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "torrent" and (r._field == "total_size"))
  |> group(columns: ["hex", "label"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["label"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_value: r._value, _field: if exists r.label then r.label else "(none)"}))
  |> group()

panels.title: Least seeded (hours)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "torrent" and (r._field == "seeding_time"))
  |> group(columns: ["name"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Torrent: r.name, Hours: float(v: r._value) / 3600.0}))
  |> sort(columns: ["Hours"], desc: false)
  |> limit(n: 10)

panels.description: Private trackers often require a minimum seeding time before a torrent may be removed.

panels.title: Days since last upload

targets.query:
from(bucket: "${bucket}")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "torrent" and (r._field == "time_since_upload"))
  |> group(columns: ["name"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._value >= 0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({Torrent: r.name, Days: float(v: r._value) / 86400.0}))
  |> sort(columns: ["Days"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 10)

panels.description: Torrents that have not uploaded for longest. Torrents that have never uploaded report -1 and are not shown.
